cases.disposition_reason: jackin --scenario outro-last --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120×40. world_for(OutroLast) in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs marks jk-9b02 CleanExited, removes its daemon, calls refresh_snapshots and sync_arbiter, and sets arbiter.entered_at_ms to -8_040_000. start in src/bin/jackin/app.rs then Go::Attach attaches jk-7f3a. populated in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs gives that instance uncommitted 2 and unpushed 1, so Instance::is_dirty in src/bin/jackin/domain/instance.rs is true. Ctrl+Q calls request_exit in src/bin/jackin/screens/capsule.rs, which opens Unsaved work — quit? and does not open Quit jackin❯?. The radio starts on Start a new agent. Two Downs then Enter, while the radio is focused, call ChoiceDialog::fire_default in src/widgets/choice_dialog.rs and fire the primary Choose button with that row. Row 2 is Quit & keep changes and calls end_instance(false), which is Go::InstanceEnded. That removes the instance and calls leave_construct in src/bin/jackin/app.rs. request_exit in src/bin/jackin/arbiter.rs sees Ok(0). World::now_ms in src/bin/jackin/sim/world.rs is clock.now_ms, and SimClock::new in src/clock.rs starts now_ms at 0, so elapsed is 8040 seconds. format_universe_duration in src/bin/jackin/rain.rs renders 2 hours 14 minutes, and OutroState::caption is You were in the Construct for 2 hours 14 minutes. Reduced render_outro draws that caption and hint Enter Close while tick < REDUCED_HOLD (45). Enter calls OutroState::skip, sets shell.quit, and the process exits 0. --frame is not used.
cases.entry_path: jackin --scenario outro-last --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40, then Ctrl+Q, Down, Down, Enter on Quit & keep changes
cases.return_path: Enter skips the outro; the process exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: The last-instance exit follows the route. The checkpoints are the first frame that contains You were in the Construct for 2 hours 14 minutes, at 120×40 and then at 80×24 after resize(80, 24), before resize(120, 40) and before Enter. Motion::Reduced in src/bin/jackin/rain.rs keeps OutroPhase::Caption while tick < REDUCED_HOLD, so reduced motion does not skip the outro. Enter calls OutroState::skip and the process exits 0, which is the restored terminal. A separate launch uses --scenario capsule-multi. world_for in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs leaves jk-9b02 Running, so after ending jk-7f3a, sync_arbiter in src/bin/jackin/sim/world.rs reports one running instance. request_exit in src/bin/jackin/arbiter.rs returns StillInside { remaining: 1 }. leave_construct in src/bin/jackin/app.rs paints Still inside the Construct · 1 instance remains through plural in src/ui/text.rs. You were in the Construct stays absent through that quit. No baseline is captured for the non-last exit. --frame is not used.
cases.action_sequence: Exit the last instance and exit when another instance remains.
cases.expected_results: Outro appears only for the last instance. The terminal is restored.
